paras: ARD (ADRO Racing Division) is ADRO's motorsport engineering program, built for drivers who demand more from their car on track. Every ARD component is developed the same way motorsport aerodynamics are: CFD simulation and track tested before anything reaches a customer. Scott, ADRO's Head of Aerodynamics, brings an F1 development background to every ARD project. The G87 M2 ARD Aero Package is one of the first full systems to come out of that program.

The component most aero kits ignore completely. The one that separates visual modifications from genuine aerodynamic systems. Most kits stop at the surfaces you can see: wings, splitters, canards. The underside of the car is where the most significant aerodynamic gains live, and it is where most kits do nothing at all.
ft: ADRO ARD Prepreg Race Undervanes for BMW G87 M2 2023+
